opening.argument: The presentation solicits Bitcoin-funded participation in a trading account, requiring viewers to register and provide a suggested minimum of $100 worth of Bitcoin. It promises that the account can grow Bitcoin and produce daily earnings, describing the benefit as passive income from trading activities. It further claims that withdrawals have no fees or penalties and will reach a Bitcoin wallet within 48 hours, while directing viewers to contact the person who sent the presentation. An optional referral program adds recruitment to the proposed opportunity. Although it qualifies the displayed figures as historical and non-guaranteed, and no deposit, withdrawal, return, or loss is shown, the material still presents a concrete funding pathway in exchange for potential daily income and Bitcoin growth.

citations.quote: To start you will need to register with MTI and fund your account with bitcoin. The suggested minimum is $100 worth of bitcoin.
The objective of Mirra Trading International is to grow your bitcoin. Your balance in trade is always in bitcoin and you earn bitcoin daily.
There are no withdrawal fees or penalties. Your requested amount will be sent to your bitcoin wallet within 48 hours.
Mirror Trading International has an optional referral program should you wish to refer your friends or new members.
For more information please contact the person who sent you this presentation.
